 Jenna Ortega To Support “Klara And The Sun” On October 19 “Late Night With Seth Meyers”
 The actress will appear on Monday’s “Late Night.”
 by 
 Brian Cantor 
 Oct 15, 2026, 1:31 am 
 LONDON, ENGLAND - OCTOBER 14: Jenna Ortega attends the "Klara And The Sun" Photocall at The Corinthia, Whitehall Penthouse on October 14, 2026 in London, England. (Photo by Joe Maher/Getty Images for Sony Pictures) 
 Ahead of the film’s October 23 release date, “Klara And The Sun” star Jenna Ortega will visit “Late Night With Seth Meyers.”
 NBC confirms Ortega as the lead interview guest for the October 19 edition of its late-night talk show. The episode will also feature Ina Garten.
 Ortega’s promotional work for “Klara” is already underway; Wednesday, she took part in an official UK photocall. One photo from the shoot appears above, courtesy of Sony Pictures.
 Other upcoming “Late Night” guests include Quinta Brunson (October 20), Stephen Graham (October 20), Owen Thiele (October 20), Liam Nelson (October 21), and Kate Berlant (October 21).
